steps.note: Start an eRFX project.
Provide the required event title.
Create Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the event line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the required 30-minute schedule.
Invite one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the configured event.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session.
Open the event's Technical-stage questionnaire as the vendor.
Verify the first Technical-stage clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the second Technical-stage clause is visible to the vendor.
Fill the vendor's technical response so terms are the submission gate being tested.
Accept only one of the two mandatory clauses.
Verify submission is blocked while the second mandatory clause remains unaccepted.
Accept the remaining mandatory clause.
Submit the completed Technical response after accepting both clauses.
Confirm the Technical response was accepted after both clauses were accepted.
Open the RFQ stage in the vendor portal to check stage-only scope.
Verify the Technical-stage clause is not shown on the RFQ stage.
Verify the second Technical-stage clause is not shown on the RFQ stage.
